description.value: Powder King Mountain Resort is a remote ski destination nestled in Pine Pass in Northern British Columbia, earning a reputation as a hidden gem with an extraordinary annual snowfall of 1,250 cm (41 feet). The main chalet houses a Dining Room & Pub and a Cafeteria, while the nearby Cafe 97 and Azouzetta Lake Lodge round out the on-mountain services. The resort operates seasonally in winter and offers summer camping at Azouzetta Lake Lodge, making it a potential stop for cyclists touring the Hart Highway corridor.

address.value: Mile 122 John Hart Hwy, Mackenzie, BC V0J 2C0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is Powder King Mountain Resort, a full ski resort in northern BC with dining (Dining Room & Pub, Cafeteria, Cafe97), lodging, and activities. The site explicitly states 'We Are Officially Closed for the 2025/26 Winter Season' as of the check date (May 2026), indicating seasonal closure rather than permanent closure. The getting-here page mentions 'PK now has high speed internet,' supporting a Wi-Fi claim, but no cycling-specific amenity evidence appears anywhere on the site.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating seasonal business at a known highway location (Mile 122 John Hart Hwy). Currently in its off-season post-winter-2025/26 closure; the resort clearly intends to reopen for 2026/27 and is accepting staff applications. Useful to touring cyclists on Hwy 97 for food, lodging, and services.
